subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Luckily, they had kept a backup key with a neighbor.”?
options: The father said the lock was convenient, but convenience should not remove every backup.
The father said the tool was useful only when it helped thinking continue.
A grandmother said she had watched her children play there every summer.
Every morning, Leo's father read news on his phone before breakfast.

本文沒有陳述「The father said the tool was useful only when it helped thinking continue.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
